_comment: Bonus B-4: derived metrics defined by config, not code. Add an object to 'metrics' and it appears in the API /tenants/{id}/orders/summary 'derived' list and on the dashboard — no redeploy of logic. 'expr' may use these variables only: orders, placed, shipped, cancelled, gross, net (gross/net are in major currency units). Operators: + - * / ( ). Division by zero yields 0. 'format' is one of currency | percent | number.
